        NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR A TYPl ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
                   1122 E. 87 STREET, CUICAGO ILLINOIS
                            PROJECT NARRATIVE

The proud new owners of a classic Chicago institution are seeking a zoning amendment from a
current MI-2 to Cl-1 classification.

Property Description:

The subject property is comprised of an irregular-shaped, 225,106.95 square foot, Ml-2 zoned
land parcel that is currently improved with an existing 26,840 square foot roller rink building.
The site has approximately 130-feet of frontage on the north side of East 87th Street by irregular
depths. The building conforms to the surrounding environs. East 87th Street is an arterial street
with industrial, office, or commercial buildings on either side of the street. The subject property
also has ample room for parking in the rear (north side) of the building.

The Fitness Factory Inc.d/b/a The Rink, located at 1122 E. 87th Street, Chicago Illinois, is a
Chicago institution. The business was operated continuously for almost 40 years in the City of
Chicago at its present location. The unfortunate death of the original owner has not led to the
end of this family-friendly roller skating rink venue but to a new beginning and journey under
the ownership of Carlos "Curtis" Pouncy and his wife Ramona Pouncy, through their ownership
of The Fitness Factory, Inc and Chicago Title Land Trust dated September 12, 1983, known as
Land Trust #1084272.
